title: AFI Analyst Calibration Record v1 (CAL-GOV CAL-SCHEMA — the sealed per-analyst calibration record)
description: (afi.analyst-calibration.v1) The sealed, append-only, per-analyst aggregation of that analyst's sealed afi.signal-reassessment.v1 artifacts, joined by signalId to the SEALED scored-signal evidence record (CAL-GOV D-CAL-1). Counts, rates and means with cluster-robust intervals, a reliability table, a rank statistic with its claim flag, strata, and a dependence block. NEVER a scalar summary of an analyst. It names no member as PoI or PoInsight — those remain the reserved on-chain per-analyst reputation primitives (CONST-GOV D-CONST-5; CAL-GOV D-CAL-5) for which this record is the off-chain evidentiary input. It lives beside, never inside, the scored record and the reassessment; it mutates neither.
$comment: BOUNDARY (CAL-GOV D-CAL-1(3)): the member set is EXHAUSTIVE — nothing more without a further filing. No composite, no scalar, no PoI/PoInsight/Rep member or label, no cross-key member, no comparison between bins. Every derived non-integer member is sealed rounded to six decimal places (round-half-even on the exact binary value); set-valued provenance members are serialized sorted ascending by UTF-16 code units; the semantic layer (tests/analyst-calibration-schema-validation.test.ts) enforces what draft-07 cannot.
x-afiPartOf: AFI Analyst Calibration Record v0.1 (CAL-GOV), slot CAL-SCHEMA
x-afiDoctrineRefs: afi-governance/decisions/analyst-calibration-record-v0.1.md D-CAL-1 (record form; exhaustive members; verify-on-read; sealing; rounding law), D-CAL-2 (grouping key; scoring identity), D-CAL-3 (estimators; minimum-N; status vocabulary; dependence block), D-CAL-4 (issuance; supersession counters), D-CAL-5 (PoI / PoInsight preserved — no member is named for either)
afi-governance/decisions/decay-lifecycle-v0.1.md D-DLC-4 (the reassessment artifact this record consumes, unchanged)
afi-governance/decisions/analyst-configuration-freedom-v0.1.md D-CFG-2 (immutability at SCORED; read-only analytics credentials; the analytics plane is non-canonical)

x-afiConstraints.sealingDiscipline: THE D-CAL-1(5) SEALING ANSWER: canonical-json-hashing.v1 (afi.hash.v1) — seal.value is the sha256 of the canonical serialization of this document with the single TOP-LEVEL member 'seal' excluded; domain tag afi.calibration.analyst carried, never hashed. Proven by governed vectors: every valid vector's seal.value reproduces under the reference implementation.
x-afiConstraints.roundingLaw: Every derived non-integer member (rate, se, interval bounds, mean, median, rho, pairingFraction, designEffect, lag1Autocorrelation, bin lower/upper) is rounded to six decimal places, round-half-even on the exact binary value — never via a half-up formatter. Semantic layer.
x-afiConstraints.sortedSets: provenance.symbols, timeframes, providers, analystConfigHashes are sorted ascending by UTF-16 code units and duplicate-free; provenance.signalIds is in accumulation order (ascending scoredAt, then signalId). Semantic layer.
x-afiConstraints.statusVocabulary: Every rate, mean, median and rho block carries status ∈ {sealed, withheld, insufficient}: sealed = estimate + interval present (block n ≥ its minimum and G ≥ 3 clusters); withheld = estimate present, interval absent (n ≥ minimum, G < 3); insufficient = counts only (n < minimum: 100 for group/strata/rank blocks, 20 for reliability bins). rank.claim is present exactly when rank.status ≠ insufficient and is 'sealed' only at n ≥ 200, else 'insufficient-for-claim'. Semantic layer.
x-afiConstraints.noScalar: No member is a single number summarizing an analyst; no key anywhere carries the token poi, poinsight, reputation, or rep_t (token-bounded, case-insensitive); no member references another groupKey. Semantic layer.
x-afiConstraints.provenanceLaw: Every uwrScore, analystId, strategy triple, riskBucket, providerId, composition member, uwrProfile stamp, recordHash and recordVersion comes from the SEALED evidence record verified on read (recordHash recomputed); every reading and realized figure comes from the SEALED reassessment verified on read (seal recomputed); timeframe and symbol are signalId-derived. n equals provenance.signalIds.length and the direction counts sum to n. Semantic layer.
x-afiConstraints.immutability: Append-only; a record is never edited; supersedes links to the previous record for the same groupKey by seal.value (D-CAL-4).

rule.description: The governed calibration rule this record was produced by (CAL-GOV D-CAL-3).

readingRule.description: The governed reading rule of the consumed reassessments (DLC-GOV D-DLC-4), copied — never re-classified.

groupKey.description: D-CAL-2: analystId × strategyId@strategyVersion × scoringIdentity × halfLifeMinutes. The record never pools keys.

scoringIdentity.description: The composition members that pin the scoring instrument on the sealed record plus the record's runtime-layer uwrProfile stamp identity (D-CAL-2(2)) — deliberately not analystConfigHash alone.

halfLifeMinutes.description: The sealed reassessment member checkpointTime.halfLifeMinutes — the key's horizon element; timeframe is signalId-derived provenance, not a key element.

attribution.description: D-CAL-3(3): 'corpus' when fewer than two distinct symbols AND lastScoredAt − firstScoredAt < 28 days — the statistics describe that corpus, not the analyst's skill.

reliability.description: D-CAL-3(2)(b): twenty bins [k·0.05, (k+1)·0.05), k = floor(round(uwrScore × 1000) / 50); every k present with its n; a rate only at n ≥ 20. No comparison between bins is ever a member.

rank.description: D-CAL-3(1)(iv): Spearman ρ(uwrScore, signedReturnPct) as Pearson on mid-ranks, interval via the influence-function CR1 sandwich and Fisher-z. Never a headline; claim 'sealed' only at n ≥ 200.

dependence.description: D-CAL-3(4): per group — overlap-cluster count (connected components at |Δt| < H), pairing integers (|Δt| ≤ H), greedy non-overlap count; per (group, f) — design effect of the win rate and lag-1 autocorrelation of signedReturnPct in scoring order.

supersedes.description: D-CAL-4(1): seal.value of the previous record for the same groupKey, or null for the first.

seal.description: CanonicalHash v1 sealing this record (x-afiConstraints.sealingDiscipline): sha256 over the canonical serialization with the top-level 'seal' member excluded; domain tag afi.calibration.analyst carried, never hashed.
